stance_rationale: The submitted risk package is a design protocol, not a verifiable risk package: covariance.parquet, alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, tail_risk.json, crowding_summary.json, exposure_matrix, factor_covariance, and specific_risk are absent. Core RF-R checks cannot be cleared by Forge-cycle promises, and the planned condition-number threshold ≤500 conflicts with the required post-shrink cond ≤100.

sigma_audit.method_selected: Ledoit-Wolf oracle shrinkage rolling 60m per sig_date; Gerber+RMT backup

regime_sigma_audit.comment: Regime counts are design-implied from 52 test months, not measured. CRISIS n≈5 is below RF-R8 threshold and has no emitted bootstrap CI.

crowding_audit.family_saturation_check: Not measured. Track 1 per-feature crowding is novel and unvalidated; Track 2 portfolio-level PG2 comparison, TDC, HHI, style correlation, and L-219 family saturation are pending.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Regime/overlay t-1 labels and vol_lag/dd_lag are not emitted; CRISIS regime testing is only specified.
FRED/ECOS validation remains TBD and feature_allowlist.csv still contains Macro_Sector wt007_f4_f4_signal.
No covariance.parquet, factor return panel, KR FF5 v2 attribution, or realized factor-return PIT audit exists.
Fundamental lag is asserted at feature-build stage, but no emitted exposure_matrix or risk decomposition proves lag-safe use in risk attribution.
No weights.csv or ADV audit exists; upstream feature build used 5e7 KRW while mandate is 2e8 KRW 20d TV.
Static alpha-stage Factor DB routing claims load_month_factors(), but this does not verify absent risk-stage artifacts.

critical_concerns.description: Required artifacts are missing: qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260517_001 does not exist, and covariance.parquet, alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, tail_risk.json, and crowding_summary.json are absent from both declared artifact locations. PD, cond, schedule, stress, and crowding checks are therefore unverifiable.

The package sets condition_number_max=500, while the role prompt and user mandate require post-shrink cond ≤100. Even the proposed acceptance criterion is too loose before any covariance artifact is emitted.

Σ decomposition BΩB'+D is not delivered. DPL B is described as implicit, but exposure_matrix.parquet, factor_covariance.parquet, specific_risk.parquet, systematic risk contribution, and factor coverage R² are all absent.

Tail risk is a protocol only: CVaR, CDaR, VaR_99, ES_99, Hill α, and realized stress losses are not emitted. The package covers 4 stress scenarios, not the required 8, and uses an 8% monthly CVaR target versus the default 2.5% cap.

CRISIS regime evidence is statistically thin: design-implied CRISIS n≈5 from 52 months, no bootstrap CI output exists, no pooled-Σ plus bounds fallback is emitted, and regime switch-rate drift is unmeasured.

Crowding diagnostics are not measurable. TDC vs PG2, HHI, style correlation, and family saturation are absent, while Track 1 per-feature crowding is explicitly an unvalidated new method rather than a cleared Acadian-style factor crowding result.
PIT claims remain open: C11 FRED/ECOS coverage is TBD, one Macro_Sector feature remains in the allowlist, C12 factor-return PIT cannot be audited, and C7 lookahead_detector is deferred to Forge.

No Silent Override is incomplete for risk: risk_challenge_note.md and final risk_package.json are absent, while the draft says objection_to_alpha=false despite alpha Codex REJECT and missing trained outputs.

Feature and sample counts remain inconsistent across artifacts: risk_package uses 634, training_protocol still references 644/895/608/850, dpl_architecture uses 1044 input features, and pit_audit concludes 895×112 despite later 634×124 claims.

supporting_arguments: The draft is transparent that this is design_phase_a and that Forge-cycle implementation is pending.
The method-shopping log avoids SR-only selection and lists Sample, Ledoit-Wolf, Gerber+RMT, and DCC-Copula candidates.
The planned per-sig_date rolling Σ design is directionally aligned with the L-326 single-snapshot warning, but it is not yet evidence.
unresolved_disputes: Whether a design-only protocol can be accepted as a risk package under AX-002.
Whether cond ≤500 was intentionally substituted for the required cond ≤100.
Whether CRISIS n≈5 can support AX-001 v2 conditional defense evaluation.
Whether TDC vs PG2 is cross-sectional, time-series, or portfolio-overlap based.
Whether the final feature universe is 1044, 955, 895, 644, 634, 608, or another set.
Whether the final tradable universe enforces 2e8 KRW 20d TV rather than inheriting the 5e7 build threshold.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that a Forge-pending design spec can substitute for emitted, PIT-verifiable covariance, tail-risk, crowding, and weights artifacts while relaxing the required post-shrink condition-number gate from ≤100 to ≤500.
rebuttal_required: Emit covariance.parquet with per-sig_date Σ, min eigenvalue > 0, post-shrink cond ≤100, and shrinkage intensity.
Emit exposure_matrix.parquet, factor_covariance.parquet, specific_risk.parquet, BΩB'+D reconciliation, factor coverage R², and systematic contribution by factor.
Emit weights.csv and verify multi-date schedule, max_names≤20, weights in [0,0.20], long-only, sum=1, turnover<600%, and 2e8 KRW liquidity.
Emit tail_risk.json with CVaR_95≤0.025 monthly cap, CDaR, VaR_99, ES_99, Hill α, bootstrap CI, and all 8 stress periods.
Emit crowding_summary.json with TDC vs PG2, HHI, style correlation, family saturation, and a clear TDC definition.
Emit risk_challenge_note.md and final risk_package.json after addressing alpha Codex REJECT dependencies.
Reconcile feature counts and remove or justify the remaining Macro_Sector feature under PIT-C11.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Alpha Codex was REJECT, Forge implementation is absent, Architect reproduction is absent, and no second independent source has passed the risk artifacts.

Is TDC vs PG2 active book computed from cross-sectional holdings overlap, time-series tail co-movement, or both?
How will DPL implicit B be reconciled to BΩB'+D with factor coverage R² ≥30%?
